title: MRI Lumbar Spine Without Contrast

required_documentation.description: Documentation of at least 6 weeks of conservative treatment attempted (physical therapy and/or NSAIDs/analgesics), unless red-flag symptoms are present.
Either symptom duration of at least 6 weeks OR a documented neurological deficit / red-flag finding.

criteria: Low back pain with radiculopathy or neurological symptoms present for at least 6 weeks.
OR red-flag symptoms present (cauda equina syndrome, progressive neurological deficit, suspected malignancy or infection, significant trauma) — conservative treatment is not required in this case.
Conservative treatment (physical therapy and/or NSAIDs/analgesics) attempted for at least 6 weeks, unless red flags above are present.
No absolute contraindication to MRI (e.g., non-MRI-compatible implant, severe claustrophobia without sedation plan) documented in the record.
notes: Synthetic policy created for this demo; not an actual InterQual criterion.
